# Thrive Dental — Bayside, Queens NY

> Thrive Dental is a full-service dental practice at 41-02 Bell Blvd, Bayside, NY 11361, serving patients from Bayside and all of Northeast Queens. Services include general dentistry, cosmetic dentistry, Invisalign® (Platinum Provider), dental implants, emergency dentistry, porcelain veneers, and teeth whitening. Phone: (718) 225-6677.

## Core Service Pages

- [General Dentistry](https://www.thrivedentalny.com/services/general-dentistry): Cleanings, exams, fillings, preventive care for all ages in Bayside, Queens.
- [Dental Implants](https://www.thrivedentalny.com/services/dental-implants): Permanent tooth replacement with 3D cone beam imaging and in-house placement. $3,500–$6,000 per implant including post, abutment, and crown.
- [Invisalign®](https://www.thrivedentalny.com/services/invisalign): Clear aligner treatment for teens and adults. Thrive Dental is an Invisalign Platinum Provider with iTero digital scanning.
- [Cosmetic Dentistry](https://www.thrivedentalny.com/services/cosmetic-dentistry): Smile makeovers including veneers, bonding, and whitening.
- [Porcelain Veneers](https://www.thrivedentalny.com/services/porcelain-veneers): Custom ceramic veneers for chips, gaps, discoloration, and shape corrections.
- [Teeth Whitening](https://www.thrivedentalny.com/services/teeth-whitening): Philips Zoom! in-office whitening (up to 8 shades brighter) and custom take-home trays.
- [Emergency Dentistry](https://www.thrivedentalny.com/services/emergency-dentistry): Same-day appointments for toothaches, broken teeth, abscesses, and knocked-out teeth.
- [Root Canal Therapy](https://www.thrivedentalny.com/services/root-canal-therapy): Comfortable root canal treatment to save infected teeth.
- [Dental Crowns](https://www.thrivedentalny.com/services/dental-crowns): Custom porcelain and zirconia crowns with digital impressions.
- [Full-Mouth Reconstruction](https://www.thrivedentalny.com/services/full-mouth-reconstruction): Comprehensive restorative treatment for patients with multiple missing, damaged, or decayed teeth.
- [Dentures](https://www.thrivedentalny.com/services/dentures): Full and partial dentures, including implant-supported options.
- [Gum Disease Treatment](https://www.thrivedentalny.com/services/gum-disease-treatment): Periodontal care — deep cleanings, scaling and root planing, and laser-assisted gum therapy.
- [Pediatric Dentistry](https://www.thrivedentalny.com/services/pediatric-dentistry): First visits, sealants, and fluoride for children.
- [Preventive Dentistry](https://www.thrivedentalny.com/services/preventive-dentistry): Exams, cleanings, oral cancer screening, and nightguards.

## Local Pages (Northeast Queens Neighborhoods Served)

All care is delivered at our single office, 41-02 Bell Blvd, Bayside, NY 11361. These pages describe how we serve nearby neighborhoods.

- [Dentist near Flushing, NY](https://www.thrivedentalny.com/dentist-flushing-ny): Serving Flushing patients — four LIRR stops (Port Washington Branch) or a straight run east on Northern Blvd.
- [Dentist near Douglaston, NY](https://www.thrivedentalny.com/dentist-douglaston-ny): Serving Douglaston — one LIRR stop east of our office, about 5 minutes by car.
- [Dentist near Little Neck, NY](https://www.thrivedentalny.com/dentist-little-neck-ny): Serving Little Neck near the Queens–Nassau line — two LIRR stops, direct via Northern Blvd.
- [Dentist near Fresh Meadows, NY](https://www.thrivedentalny.com/dentist-fresh-meadows-ny): Serving Fresh Meadows — about 10 minutes east via Union Tpke or the LIE service road.
- [Dentist near Oakland Gardens, NY](https://www.thrivedentalny.com/dentist-oakland-gardens-ny): Serving Oakland Gardens — a few minutes north on Bell Blvd.
